weightedMethodConfig.description:
linear: the color difference between a value and its next greater value is equal regardless of the difference
weighted: the color difference between two values is proportional to the difference between two values
e.g. If we want to color 1,2,3,9 with 2 colors
In linear mode, 1 and 2 have the same color, and 3 and 9 have the other color.
In weighted mode, 1, 2, and 3 have the same color, and 9 have the other color.
If weightedMethodConfig is not set, linear method is used.

numberOfColors.description:
If null, each unique value will have a distinct color.
If method is linear and numberOfColors is 2, the top 50% values will have one color and the bottom 50% will have another.
If method is weighted and numberOfColors is 2, values in the top 50% range will have one color and those in the bottom 50% will have another.
